instructions:
1. Sit at the low cable row station with feet braced on the platform and knees slightly bent.
2. Grasp the handle with both hands and sit upright with a straight back.
3. Extend your arms fully and let the weight stretch your shoulder blades forward.
4. Pull the handle to your lower abdomen, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Extend your arms back to the start under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and avoid swinging back to move the weight.
2. Lead the pull with your elbows, not your hands.
3. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of each pull.
4. Exhale as you pull and inhale as you return.
name: Cable low seated row

instructions:
1. Attach a handle to a low pulley and lie on a flat bench with your head near the pulley.
2. Grasp the handle and extend your arms over your chest with a slight bend in the elbows.
3. Lower the handle in an arc behind your head until you feel a stretch through your lats and chest.
4. Pull the handle back over your chest in the same arc.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep a slight, fixed bend in your elbows throughout.
2. Drive the movement from your lats and chest, not your arms.
3. Stop the stretch before your lower back arches off the bench.
4. Exhale as you pull over and inhale as you lower behind your head.
name: Cable lying extension pullover (with cables attachment)

instructions:
1. Set a flat bench between two low cable pulleys and lie back with feet flat on the floor.
2. Grasp a handle in each hand and press them up over your chest with a slight bend in the elbows.
3. Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch across your chest.
4. Bring the handles back together over your chest in the same arc.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep a fixed slight bend in your elbows so it stays a fly, not a press.
2. Squeeze your chest as the handles meet at the top.
3. Control the lowering phase to keep tension on the chest.
4. Exhale as you bring the handles together and inhale as you lower them.
name: Cable lying fly

instructions:
1. Attach a straight bar to the cable and lie on a flat bench with your head near the pulley.
2. Grasp the bar with an overhand grip and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
3. Bend only at the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead, keeping your upper arms still.
4. Extend your arms back up until they are nearly vertical, squeezing your triceps.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms fixed and move only your forearms.
2. Point your elbows up and slightly in to keep tension on the triceps.
3. Stop the bar near your forehead, not on it.
4. Exhale as you extend and inhale as you lower.
name: Cable lying triceps extension

instructions:
1. Set a flat bench beside a low cable pulley with the head of the bench near the stack.
2. Lie back, grasp a straight bar with an overhand grip, and extend your arms over your shoulders.
3. Bend only at the elbows to lower the bar behind your head until you feel a triceps stretch.
4. Press the bar back up until your arms are nearly vertical, squeezing your triceps.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms still and move only your forearms.
2. Position the bench close enough that the cable stays loaded at the stretch.
3. Let the bar travel behind your head to load the long head of the triceps.
4. Exhale as you extend and inhale as you lower.
name: Cable lying triceps extension (low)
